nd.screen.hint: The native desktop on the monitor plugged into this box.
nd.full.hint: A real desktop, fr: NoCapOS sign-in, a dock with Files, Settings, Software, Terminal, Text Editor and a web browser, plus your Linux apps. Sign in with this server's Linux accounts.
nd.off.hint: Just the text console. Nothing graphical runs, pure server energy.
nd.noScreen: No screen detected rn. Plug one in to use NoCap Desktop.
nd.notSetUp: NoCap Desktop isn't set up on this server yet.
nd.confirmBody: Whoever is signed in on the server's screen gets signed out, and unsaved stuff there is gone.
nd.autologin.hint: The server's screen opens your desktop with no password after it starts. Anyone at the screen can use it, so choose wisely.
nd.open.hint: See and use the server's screen right here, in a window. Same screen, always: sign in here and you're in on the screen too.
nd.win.signIn: Sign-in screen. Sign in here and the server's screen is in too
nd.win.switching: Following the screen to its new session…
nd.win.closedBody: The screen dipped. The desktop may have restarted or signed out.
nd.win.title: The server's screen
nd.health.ok: All good, NoCap Desktop is on the screen
nd.health.broken: Something's off: the screen may be black
nd.health.p.not_at_boot: The sign-in screen isn't set to start when the server boots.
nd.health.p.not_graphical: The server boots to the text console, not the desktop.
nd.health.p.dm_failed: The sign-in screen crashed and stopped.
nd.health.p.no_shell: The sign-in screen runs, but GNOME Shell never showed up (that's the black screen).
nd.health.p.no_session: The NoCapOS session files are missing.
nd.health.p.no_xorg: Xorg isn't installed, so there's no backup if Wayland can't run on this graphics card.
nd.health.p.kiosk_left: Bits of the old web full screen are still here.
nd.health.p.services_held: The installer left services on hold.
nd.health.fallback.xorg: Running on Xorg instead of Wayland so it works on this graphics card.
nd.health.fallback.software: Running on Xorg with software rendering and the standard sign-in look so it works here.
nd.repair.hint: Fixes the boot setup, puts back missing session files, clears old leftovers and, if the screen stays black, switches to a setup that works here. Then the screen restarts.
nd.repair.confirmBody: The server's screen restarts. Whoever is signed in there gets signed out, and unsaved stuff there is gone.
nd.repair.done: NoCap Desktop repaired, the screen is restarting
nd.diag.hint: The logs behind the screen: sign-in screen, GNOME Shell, sessions, graphics card. Copy them when you ask for help.
